x-e-e5-01.title: 'Most popular' - texte asûtenu ni?
x-e-e5-01.topic: Idée principale na détails ti soutien
x-e-e5-01.goal: Bâ so information ti nombres na texte asûtenu tënë (popular) wala pëpe, na sara question anglaise so alingbi ti vérifier tënë.
x-e-e5-01.material:
Classe ti Mina ayeke na coin ti lecture na étagère ti livres.

Our class has a reading corner. There are 20 books on the shelf. Twelve of them are about animals. Four are about space, and four are story books. The teacher did not buy any new books this year.

Mina atene, "Animal books are the most popular in our class."

x-e-e5-01.thinking.1: Ti fa ndulu ti ye so 'ayeke' na ye so 'a diko ni'
x-e-e5-01.thinking.2: Ti sara question so akiri preuve so angbâ pëpe
x-e-e5-01.prereq.0: Mots ti nzoni tongana most, popular na about
x-e-e5-01.prereq.1: Mots ti nombres tongana Twelve na four
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.prompt: Zia décision so texte asûtenu tënë ti Mina (livres ti animaux ayeke popular ahon) wala pëpe.

x-e-e5-01.s.s1.r.a: Kiri bâ so mo bâ nombre ti livres na nombre ti ngoi so a diko ni tongana ye même wala pëpe.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.o.b: Preuve ayeke suffisante pëpe. Ni ayeke na nombre ti livres gï, na ni atene pëpe livres wa élèves adiko.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.r.b: Mbi mû pene pene so information so tënë a besoin ni na information so texte amû ayeke même wala pëpe.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.o.c: Preuve ayeke suffisante. Professeur avo livres vandâ pëpe, ni la élèves adiko gï livres ti kozo.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.r.c: Vérifier so 'avo livres vandâ pëpe' akanga na livres wa ayeke popular.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.explain: Texte atene gï nombre ti livres na étagère (livres ti animaux 12, na ambeni). Ni atene pëpe livres wa élèves adiko wala aprêter mingi, ni la e lingbi ti vérifier tënë 'most popular' pëpe.
x-e-e5-01.s.s2.prompt: Ti vérifier so tënë ti Mina ayeke nzoni wala pëpe, question wa mo lingbi ti hunda élèves? Gbâ phrase ti question anglaise oko.

x-e-e5-01.s.s2.hint.1: Gbâ question so ahunda na action so, na zia point d'interrogation na nzoroko.
x-e-e5-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Réponse ti question ti mbi afa 'livres wa a diko ni mingi'?
x-e-e5-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ni ahunda ye so élèves asara na place ti ti hunda nombre ti livres?
